instruction.text: Raina is feeling restless and bored. The weather outside is nice and her rainmaking skills aren’t needed. What should Edgar suggest?

b.sound: Go outside and get some fresh air. Maybe even get active and play with a ball.
Stay inside and stare at the wall. The boredom will pass.

feedback.end: Having a healthy lifestyle means living your life in a healthy way. Being active and outside is part of a healthy lifestyle.

instruction.text: Now that Raina is outside, she wants to get active. Find the active person on the picture.

feedback.end: This is Horace Hoop, Raina’s friend. He loves being active. He invites Raina to play his favourite game of basketball.

instruction.text: Choose the picture of Raina and Horace playing basketball to hear why Horace loves the game so much.

feedback.end: Basketball is amazing! You can take shots alone or play against friends in a game. Even if the weather is bad, you can still play on an indoor court.

instruction.text: A few days later, Raina would rather get active indoors. What should Edgar suggest?

b.sound: Turn on some music and dance! You'll have fun and work up a sweat at the same time.
Let’s just watch TV. There is no way to get active indoors.

feedback.end: There are plenty of ways to get active indoors. Dancing is one of the easiest ways. All you need is some good music.

instruction.text: Where do these activities usually take place: indoors or outdoors? Drag them into the correct groups.
